Policy. The policy applies to laptops, mobile devices, and any cloud services
provisioned by IT.

Prohibited activities include sharing credentials, installing unapproved
software, and storing customer data on personal devices. Violations may result
in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

Employees should report suspected violations to the security team within 24
hours of discovery.

Onboarding Guide for New Engineers

New engineers should expect a two-week onboarding program. Week one focuses on
environment setup, security training, and codebase orientation. Week two
focuses on shipping a small starter task with a designated buddy.

All new engineers receive a MacBook Pro with 32 GB of RAM by default. Requests
for additional hardware should be filed through the IT portal.

The first 1:1 with the engineering manager happens on day three. Buddies are
assigned by the team lead within 48 hours of the engineer's start date.

IntraMind Q4 2024 Earnings Summary

Total revenue for Q4 2024 was 12.4 million dollars, up 18 percent year over year.
Operating expenses came in at 8.1 million dollars. Net income was 3.2 million
dollars, exceeding the analyst consensus of 2.9 million dollars.

The North America region contributed 7.5 million dollars in revenue, while EMEA
contributed 3.1 million dollars and APAC contributed 1.8 million dollars.

The board of directors approved a quarterly dividend of 0.15 dollars per share,
payable on March 15, 2025.
